Python observability: Use structlog JSON logs with consistent fields; include user, request, and operation context. Propagate a unique correlation ID through all requests, logs, and spans. Track latency, traffic, errors, and saturation at every service boundary using Prometheus metrics; use OpenTelemetry distributed tracing. Use context managers for timing and error handling; test logs and metrics in integration tests; set up alerts.

Keep metric label values bounded. Unbounded labels (like user IDs) explode storage costs. Avoid labels with unbounded values to prevent metric explosion. Never use unbounded values as metric labels.
